summary: Madonna and Child in the State Hermitage Museum (GE-249), bought from Count Antonio Litta in Milan in 1865.

timeline.text: Madonna nursing the Child. Its execution is attributed by some to Leonardo and by others to a pupil on his design.

claims.value: St Petersburg, State Hermitage Museum, GE-249

claims.value: Bought 12 January 1865 from Count Antonio Litta, Milan
claims.statement: The Hermitage history page records purchase on 12 January 1865; Stepan Gedeonov, director of the Imperial Hermitage, chose four paintings in Milan from the Litta collection for 100,000 francs.

claims.statement: Many scholars attribute the execution to a pupil working on Leonardo's design (Boltraffio is the name most often proposed; the 2011 National Gallery exhibition discussed this). Holders not verified in this session.
